titles.title: Scientific Oversight for Unbiased and Neutral Data in Pesticide Research Act
SOUND Pesticide Research Act
SOUND Pesticide Research Act

To amend the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to direct the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency to rely on certain data with respect to a toxicity determination related to a pesticide chemical residue, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.
